_comment: Synthetic example (TASK-162: the repo is public, the client's real name is never committed). The real file is config/wa-client.json, gitignored -- see .gitignore and app/wa/config.py:client(). "name": the client's name, used wherever Luna/Daria name their employer to a candidate or an operator. "own_mail_domains": mail domains the email tools (tools/email_index.py, email_ledgers.py, email_stage2b.py) treat as ours, not an external clinic/candidate. "partner_mail_domains": mail domains the email tools treat as the client's own partner (e.g. the person who talks to clinics), unioned into the own-domain set where that tool already did so.
